scope: Native Skill-Up effect-check UI/API, container-only validation/execution, bounded report ingestion and conservative cross-version regression comparisons.

skillUp.installation: Official Linux amd64 release binary, checksum verified; not redistributed in source.

checks.note: Opt-in external CLI tests skip by default. Docker execution uses explicit command/protocol fixtures, not a daemon.

checks.check: Focused application and parser race regression

checks.note: After the host regression, a final narrow guard rejects all unverified judge: identities, including a malicious ID ending in :rule. The affected cross-version comparison test passed again under race.
Clean HOME and explicit mock command; no LLM, private credentials or third-party skill executed. Runtime result.json was read by the adapter.

checks.command: RUNDESK_TEST_SKILLUP_BIN=<official binary> RUNDESK_TEST_SKILLUP_FIXTURE_DIR=<trusted fixture> RUNDESK_TEST_SKILLUP_REPORT=<actual result.json> go test ./internal/skillcheck -run ^TestLiveOfficialValidationAndResultProtocol$ -v -count=1
checks.note: Validate success/cases=1; normalized custom engine result has unknown model identity and cannot self-attest a passing comparison.

JSDOM: explicit consent/default no network, fixed snapshot, report import trust, per-case variants, cross-version selection, cleanupPending across cancellation/restart, failed cleanup retry and context/draft preservation. No browser geometry acceptance.

checks.check: Linux amd64 and Windows amd64 CGO-disabled builds
checks.note: Final source and embedded UI. Linux binary reports RunDesk 0.74.0; Windows cross-compiled only.

checks.check: Compiled host HTTP and static-asset smoke
checks.note: Disposable demo service: version/capability, native effect-check JS/CSS, global reports route, unavailable Docker not presented as ready.

checks.check: Complete source SHA256SUMS manifest and release hygiene

limits: No Docker CLI/daemon is available in this verification environment. Actual container startup, cgroups, mounts, cleanup and daemon behavior require target-machine acceptance.
No real LLM, Codex/Claude/Qoder model evaluation, script/Agent Judge effect or business workload is accepted. The official mock only verifies protocol transport.
Windows/macOS runtime and real-browser visual layout have not been accepted.

Automatic regression gates are deliberately limited to root SKILL.md changes, identical other file/image/model/configuration/input identities and built-in grading/gates. Unknown/script/Agent judge identities cannot establish a passing gate.
Imported reports are external_unverified; they never self-attest source/suite identity and do not change the security installation gate.
No host execution fallback, credential auto-mount, automatic test/repair, marketplace publication or runtime security enforcement is included.
Existing real SkillSpector and marketplace verification remains in the 0.73.1 archive, separate from this release; those live checks were not claimed as rerun.
